first_training_average.source_rule: baseline_8b.py calls average(step//20, step); its sparse selector uses round_number while matchmaking uses epoch as global_step

scope.description: Deterministic CPU-only mechanics from the pinned local Agora/Hivemind code. No DHT or network process is started.

sparse_selector.size_rule: Torch random permutation labels elements modulo num_partitions; each partition has floor/ceil cardinality

tensor_assignment.client_rule: CLIENT fraction is zero, but NODE and CLIENT weights are both one and both are senders
tensor_assignment.native_allocation_rule: load_balance_peers(dense_total_elements, bandwidths) with None for NODE, 0 for CLIENT; with no positive specified bandwidth only NODE receives equal score
tensor_assignment.native_sparse_path: SPARTA compacts selected coordinates into one tensor per source tensor before TensorPartContainer chunks them; the dense-derived fractions are normalized over the compact sparse total
